joins_review.note: ASK cold open lands the composer answer; BLUF picks up with 'The easy read — the one the word template invites — is that finance picks the chart.' — no dangling reference, natural continuation.
BLUF ends 'It is the failure mode.' → MECHANISM Act 1 opens with 'First design decision, and it is the sharpest.' — the 'First' numeric label is now the true first ordinal in the Short.
'…less flashy.' → 'Second decision.' Coherent enumerated flow (First → Second).
'…the servers return four oh three.' → 'Third decision…' Coherent enumeration (First → Second → Third).

'Never render past a failed audit.' → 'The verdict.' Fourth decision (colour + geometry) is dropped, but the verdict beat compactly restates it ('Profit and loss are always encoded twice, because greyscale kills the colour alone read') so the compression is self-contained.
Verdict '…the reel earns the boilerplate charge it exists to refute.' → 'That was the finance Skill. Liam, in for Bear.' Clean title-restate close.
